record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:74 — P2/conf100 `uniqueGuests` doesn't exclude the organizer (`organizer.email` / `booking.userPrimaryEmail`) or team hosts, so the host can be added as an attendee of their own booking, which duplicates them in the calendar invite and sends them both an OrganizerAddGuestsEmail and an AttendeeScheduledEmail.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` only filters out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails, but does not exclude the organizer (`organizer.email` / `booking.userPrimaryEmail`) or other hosts/team members. If the organizer (or a host) email is submitted in `guests` and they are not already in `booking.attendees`, the code will create a new attendee record for that email (`attendees.createMany`). Later, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` iterates over `calendarEvent.attendees` and, for any attendee whose email is in `newGuests` (the raw `guests` input), sends an `AttendeeScheduledEmail`. Separately it always sends `OrganizerAddGuestsEmail` to the organizer (and team members). This can cause the organizer/host to be treated as an attendee too, leading to duplicate/incorrect notifications and potentially duplicate attendees in calendar updates.
